fusions.name: Tearing Mouthful
fusions.desc: A tearing bite that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 2 seconds, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Swallowed Whole
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 20% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. You bite for 20 damage and use up every affliction on it, adding 1.3 times the damage they had left, and heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Wedged Larder
fusions.desc: Eats every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Unhurried Digestion
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 2 stamina a second for 10 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
